leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement the two-pointer approach to calculate trapped rainwater
Construct a function that iterates through elevation data using left and right pointers
Manipulate pointer positions based on elevation comparisons
Initialize variables to track maximum heights on both sides
Apply conditional logic to determine water accumulation at each position
Integrate the algorithm to process elevation arrays of varying lengths
Render the total trapped water value after processing the input
